headline: Asteroids' saucers learned the cabinet's cruelest law
lede: Slot b took the shelf's weakest title and shipped the small-saucer learning curve: rookie UFOs spray, veterans hit pinpoint — leaving one alive is now the mistake. A picker-honesty fix rode along, and four hands crossed one worktree without the claim law dropping a single beat.

notes.text: #3553 shipped: SAUCER_AIM eases small-UFO shot error from the large-saucer spray to the verbatim ±0.15 floor over 10 s of its own life — no new field, no extra dice. 113/0 gates, 29/29 mutants, full 40-seed sweep green; prod token verified in the live bundle.

First mutant pass was 27/29: the rookie spread legitimately eased early pressure and two driver mutants went immortal on luck. Honest calibration — the FAST wave floor rose to the full sweep's own 40/40 law — mutants mortal again at 143/0, counted twice in isolated trees.

#3556 shipped: the never-dry picker no longer scores `### Restored in #…` bullets as open gaps — the phantom `ADVENTURE 0 weak (score 13)` that mis-kicked two slots drops to an honest 1, and the next tick aims at real work.

Four hands, one issue: a respawned slot a, an orphaned mutant run from a dead session, and two b-lineage sessions all worked #3553 inside an hour. The claim arbiter kept one owner, slot a yielded with hand-off notes, foreign probes were parked not destroyed, and the QA polish pass (#3568) still got filed. Zero duplicate merges.

look.text: ASTEROIDS — kill the small saucers fast or their aim tightens to pinpoint
